messages:
sophie: hi team! finalizing my first-week checklist — quick Q: where do we keep the canonical templates (notes, runbooks, postmortems) in Notion? I can see pages but not sure which one to duplicate from
leon: welcome, sophie :wave:  short answer: Company Home > DevEx > Team Templates has everything canonical. meeting notes, runbook, postmortem, and product-spec templates are in that page.
sophie: thanks — I clicked into Team Templates but the top shows 'Can view' and the 'Duplicate' option is disabled. is that expected?
tia: yep that's normal if you're not in the Docs Editors group. we lock the templates to prevent accidental edits. you should be able to use 'Duplicate' once you're in the group. two ways to get access: 1) click 'Request edit access' on the page, or 2) we can add you via Okta.
sophie: I clicked Request edit access, it showed a popup but no confirmation email. any idea how long it takes?
leon: normally < 5m. sometimes the Okta sync lags. if it doesn't come through, ping @devex here or DM me and I can add you manually.
tia: I can also run the add. I usually set perms like this: Owner = page creator, Editors = Redwood - Docs Editors, Viewers = Everyone at Redwood. we also enforce that new public pages are added to the index database so search works.
sophie: thanks tia. small follow-up: when I duplicate the meeting notes template, should I put it under our team page or keep it in a personal workspace and link it?
leon: team pages are preferred for anything useful to others. put it under Company Home > Teams > <Your Team> so it shows up in the team index. if it's a personal draft you can keep in your workspace and then move it once ready. just remember to add it to the Team Docs index table and add tags.
tia: quick checklist we ask new page creators to follow (copy-pasteable):
```
- Title: Clear short title
- Owner: @your-name
- Summary: 1-2 line description
- Tags: #runbook #infra (choose relevant)
- Add to: Company Home > DevEx > Index DB (use 'Add to index' button)
- Permissions: Editors = Redwood - Docs Editors; Viewers = Everyone at Redwood
```
sophie: perfect, that'll help. also any naming conventions for runbooks vs playbooks?
leon: runbooks = operational steps (alerts, page to page triage). playbooks = longer guides (onboarding, runbook creation). prefix runbooks with "RB-" if it's infra-critical is optional but we try to keep names descriptive: "RB - kc-wallet cache clear" or "Playbook - new-service onboarding"
sophie: got it. I got an email from devex-bot saying access granted — can duplicate now :tada: any last tips for linking into the index DB?
tia: when you add the page to the index DB, fill Owner, Tags, Short Summary, and select a Parent Team. if you want me to glance before you publish, drop the link and I'll review for style + tags.
devex-bot: devex-bot added sophie to "Redwood - Docs Editors" (okta)
sophie: awesome thanks everyone, i'll duplicate the meeting notes and add it to our team page and ping for review if needed :)
